Geographies Served Programs The Museum of Art & Photography (MAP) District Bangalore State Karnataka District Bangalore States Karnataka MAP, the Museum of Art & Photography in Bengaluru, is a five-storey cultural centre featuring art galleries, an auditorium, a research library, an education centre, and a specialized facility. Its inclusive design caters to visitors with special needs, while the facade's unique steel panels symbolize the preservation of art. Strategically located near major metro stations and landmarks, MAP embraces the community with diverse educational programmes, preserving Indian art and heritage under the guidance of the MAP Architectural Committee. It stands as an iconic architecture dedicated to promoting art and photography for all. Collection of Art Services District Bangalore State Karnataka District Bangalore States Karnataka The Art & Photography Foundation manages an extensive collection of art, photography, textiles, and design from the subcontinent, gifted by Abhishek and Radhika Poddar. It is divided into six departments: Pre-Modern Art, Textiles, Craft & Design, Living Traditions, Popular Culture, and Modern & Contemporary Art. The Pre-Modern Art section includes miniature paintings, Chola bronzes, and more. Modern & Contemporary Art features artists like M.F. Husain and Jitish Kallat. Popular Culture showcases woodcut prints, Kalighat paintings, and Bollywood paraphernalia. Living Traditions displays regional artistic practices, and Textiles, Craft & Design includes textile traditions and decorative arts. The Photography section spans works from the 19th century to contemporary times. Milestones & Track Record The Museum of Art & Photography (MAP) was launched in 2020 and has emerged as a dynamic institution, featuring a diverse collection and a commitment to learning and engagement. --> --> Leadership Team Abhishek Poddar Trustee Som Mittal Trustee Arundhati Nag Trustee Radhika Poddar Trustee Arnika Ahldag Head of Curation and Exhibition Carolina Artegiani Head of Development and Inclusion Shilpa Vijayakrishnan Head of Education & Outreach Mandara Vishwanath Head of Collections Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AABTT9359A Registration Number 42/11-12/09-05-2011 CSR Form 1 CSR00000053 80G AABTT9359AF20214 12A AABTT9359AE20214 FCRA 094421619 About Headquarters Bangalore, Karnataka Since 2011 Demographies Served Youth Women Children Men Artisans --> Impact The Foundation's key project is the building of the Museum of Art & Photography (MAP) in Bengaluru, which aims to transform the perception of museums as spaces for ideas, stories, and cultural exchange. Vision and Mission The Foundation aims to build, manage and sustain a new museum to exhibit, interpret and preserve a growing collection of art and cultural artifacts, motivated by a belief that museums should play a positive role in society.
